answer.reason: The verses tell of Achish's dealings with David: his judgment that David was mad, the gift of Ziklag, and the sending back from battle.

clauses.english: took David for a madman when he came fleeing to Gath
clauses.quote: Lo, ye see the man is mad

clauses.english: gave David the town of Ziklag
clauses.quote: Then Achish gave him Ziklag that day

clauses.english: sent David back from the battle because the Philistine lords did not favour him
clauses.quote: nevertheless the lords favour thee not

doubts: 1KI 2:39-40 names an Achish son of Maachah, king of Gath, in Solomon's time, probably a different man, so I left those verses out.
